verdict.rationale: Lovable explicitly documents exporting/syncing code to GitHub/GitLab, downloading the codebase, and deploying outside Lovable ('test features on branches, and deploy outside Lovable'), which directly satisfies the story of deploying the generated app to external infrastructure. This is first-party documentation without independent hands-on confirmation of a successful external deploy. Missing for 10: independent/community verification that exported code actually deploys cleanly on a third-party host, and more detail on CI/CD or infra setup beyond raw code export.
